Privacy policyDelete account

Delete your Newworld Cargo account

You can request deletion of your account and associated personal data here without installing the app or signing in.

Request by email

  1. Email info@newworldcargo.com with the subject Newworld Cargo account deletion.
  2. Include the email address or phone number registered to your account. Never send your password, authentication code, or payment PIN.
  3. Our support team will verify account ownership and respond about completion and any records that must be retained.
Email deletion request

If an email app does not open, use your preferred email service to contact the address above.

Request in the app

Open Settings > Delete account > Request account deletion, then confirm. A recorded request is not immediate deletion.

What is deleted

After ownership verification, we delete your account and associated profile, saved contacts, saved places, and uploaded personal data that we no longer need.

What may be retained

Shipment, invoice, payment, fraud-prevention, and dispute records may be retained where needed to complete a service or meet legal obligations, only for as long as those obligations apply. Our response will identify retained categories and the applicable retention period. Contact support for the status of a pending request or to request deletion of specific personal data.
